notes: «وغير، واحد» is an unnamed plural teacher, one of the co-transmitters at the first level.
«فذكر نحو حديث يحيى بن سعيد» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route.
Tirmidhi's remark that Abu Asim (Dahhak b. Makhlad) added a wording is a pure wording variant and is left out; the ten Companions in the gathering are scene only.
